verdict.rationale: Pulumi's testing guide documents three test types. Unit tests run fast and in-memory with all external calls mocked, so nothing touches production. Property tests run assertions during deployment, and integration tests deploy ephemeral infrastructure. Tests are written in the program's own language with native frameworks like Mocha or NUnit, and `pulumi preview` adds a no-change dry run. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the testing workflow.
